x: The great Ḥizb, companion to the Ḥizb al-Baḥr — as that one is of the sea, this is of the land. Thirty-six bands: the disjoined letters, the long petitions of poverty and incapacity, the complaint of Yaʿqūb, and the Ibrāhīmiyya at the close.
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina sh-shayṭāni r-rajīm.
I take refuge in Allāh from the accursed Satan.

وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ ۖ أَنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوءًا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِن بَعْدِهِ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Wa-idhā jāʾaka lladhīna yuʾminūna bi-āyātinā fa-qul salāmun ʿalaykum, kataba Rabbukum ʿalā nafsihi r-raḥmata, annahu man ʿamila minkum sūʾan bi-jahālatin thumma tāba min baʿdihi wa-aṣlaḥa fa-annahu ghafūrun raḥīm.

And when those who believe in Our signs come to you, say: peace be upon you. Your Lord has prescribed mercy upon Himself — that whoever among you does evil in ignorance and then repents thereafter and makes amends, He is Forgiving, Merciful.

بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُ صَاحِبَةٌ ۖ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصَارَ ۖ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ

Badīʿu s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, annā yakūnu lahu waladun wa-lam takun lahu ṣāḥibatun, wa-khalaqa kulla shayʾin, wa-huwa bi-kulli shayʾin ʿalīm. Dhālikumu llāhu Rabbukum, lā ilāha illā huwa, khāliqu kulli shayʾin fa-ʿbudūhu, wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin Wakīl. Lā tudrikuhu l-abṣāru wa-huwa yudriku l-abṣāra, wa-huwa l-Laṭīfu l-Khabīr.

Originator of the heavens and the earth — how should He have a son when He has no consort, and He created all things, and He is Knower of all things? That is Allāh, your Lord; there is no god but He, Creator of all things, so worship Him; and He is Guardian over all things. Vision does not overtake Him, but He overtakes all vision; and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.
الٓر ۚ كٓهيعٓص ۚ حمٓ ۚ عٓسٓقٓ ۚ رَبِّ احْكُم بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
Alif Lām Rāʾ · Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād · Ḥāʾ Mīm · ʿAyn Sīn Qāf · Rabbi-ḥkum bi-l-ḥaqq, wa-rabbunā r-Raḥmānu l-Mustaʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūn.
Alif Lām Rāʾ · Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād · Ḥāʾ Mīm · ʿAyn Sīn Qāf. My Lord, judge with truth. And our Lord is the All-Merciful, whose help is sought against what you describe.

طه ۚ مَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَىٰ إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ وَالسَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى الرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَىٰ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَىٰ وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ

Ṭā Hā. Mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-Qurʾāna li-tashqā. Illā tadhkiratan li-man yakhshā. Tanzīlan mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wa-s-samāwāti l-ʿulā. Ar-Raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi stawā. Lahu mā fī s-samāwāti wa-mā fī l-arḍi wa-mā baynahumā wa-mā taḥta th-tharā. Wa-in tajhar bi-l-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu s-sirra wa-akhfā. Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa, lahu l-asmāʾu l-ḥusnā.

Ṭā Hā. We have not sent down the Qurʾān upon you that you be distressed, but as a reminder to him who fears — a revelation from Him who created the earth and the high heavens. The All-Merciful established Himself upon the Throne. To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is beneath the soil. And if you speak aloud — He knows the secret, and what is yet more hidden. Allāh: there is no god but He; to Him belong the most beautiful Names.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي بِالجَهَالَةِ مَعْرُوفٌ، وَأَنْتَ بِالعِلْمِ مَوْصُوفٌ، وَقَدْ وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ جَهَالَتِي بِعِلْمِكَ، فَسِعْ ذٰلِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ كَمَا وَسِعْتَهُ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Allāhumma innaka taʿlamu annī bi-l-jahālati maʿrūf, wa-anta bi-l-ʿilmi mawṣūf, wa-qad wasiʿta kulla shayʾin min jahālatī bi-ʿilmika, fa-siʿ dhālika bi-raḥmatika kamā wasiʿtahu bi-ʿilmika, wa-ghfir lī, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

O Allāh, You know that I am marked by ignorance, and that You are described by knowledge. You have encompassed by Your knowledge all of my ignorance — so let Your mercy encompass it as Your knowledge has encompassed it, and forgive me. You have power over all things.

يَا اللهُ يَا مَالِكُ يَا وَهَّابُ، هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ نَعْمَائِكَ مَا عَلِمْتَ لَنَا فِيهِ رِضَاكَ، وَاكْسُنَا كِسْوَةً تَقِينَا بِهَا مِنَ الفِتَنِ فِي جَمِيعِ عَطَايَاكَ، وَقَدِّسْنَا عَنْ كُلِّ وَصْفٍ يُوجِبُ نَقْصًا مِمَّا اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ، يَا اللهُ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَلِيُّ يَا كَبِيرُ. نَسْأَلُكَ الفَقْرَ مِمَّا سِوَاكَ وَالغِنَىٰ بِكَ حَتَّىٰ لَا نَشْهَدَ إِلَّا إِيَّاكَ، وَالْطُفْ بِنَا فِيهِمَا لُطْفًا عَلِمْتَهُ يَصْلُحُ لِمَنْ وَالاكَ، وَاكْسُنَا جَلَابِيبَ لِعِصْمَةٍ فِي الأَنْفَاسِ وَاللَّحَظَاتِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا عَبِيدًا لَكَ فِي جَمِيعِ الحَالَاتِ، وَعَلِّمْنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ عِلْمًا نَصِيرُ بِهِ كَامِلِينَ فِي المَحْيَا وَالمَمَاتِ

Yā Allāh, yā Mālik, yā Wahhāb, hab lanā min naʿmāʾika mā ʿalimta lanā fīhi riḍāk, wa-ksunā kiswatan taqīnā bihā mina l-fitani fī jamīʿi ʿaṭāyāk, wa-qaddisnā ʿan kulli waṣfin yūjibu naqṣan mimmā staʾtharta bihi fī ʿilmika ʿamman siwāk, yā Allāh, yā ʿAẓīm, yā ʿAlī, yā Kabīr. Nasʾaluka l-faqra mimmā siwāka wa-l-ghinā bika ḥattā lā nashhada illā iyyāk, wa-lṭuf binā fīhimā luṭfan ʿalimtahu yaṣluḥu li-man wālāk, wa-ksunā jalābība li-ʿiṣmatin fī l-anfāsi wa-l-laḥaẓāt, wa-jʿalnā ʿabīdan laka fī jamīʿi l-ḥālāt, wa-ʿallimnā min ladunka ʿilman naṣīru bihi kāmilīna fī l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt.

O Allāh, O Owner, O Bestower: grant us of Your favours that in which You know Your good pleasure lies for us; clothe us in a garment by which You guard us from trial in all Your gifts; and sanctify us from every quality entailing a deficiency in what You have kept to Yourself in Your knowledge, apart from all besides You. O Allāh, O Magnificent, O Most High, O Great. We ask You for poverty toward all but You, and for richness through You, until we witness none but You; and be gentle with us in both with a gentleness You know befits those who take You for a friend. Clothe us in the robes of protection in every breath and every glance; make us slaves to You in all our states; and teach us from Your presence a knowledge by which we become complete in life and in death.

اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الحَمِيدُ الرَّبُّ المَجِيدُ، الفَعَّالُ لِمَا يُرِيدُ، تَعْلَمُ فَرَحَنَا بِمَاذَا وَلِمَاذَا وَعَلَىٰ مَاذَا، وَتَعْلَمُ حُزْنَنَا كَذٰلِكَ، وَقَدْ أَوْجَبْتَ كَوْنَ مَا أَرَدْتَهُ فِينَا وَمِنَّا، وَلَا نَسْأَلُكَ دَفْعَ مَا تُرِيدُ، وَلٰكِنْ نَسْأَلُكَ التَّأْيِيدَ بِرُوحٍ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فِيمَا تُرِيدُ، كَمَا أَيَّدْتَ أَنْبِيَاءَكَ وَرُسُلَكَ وَخَاصَّةَ الصِّدِّيقِينَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Allāhumma anta l-Ḥamīdu r-Rabbu l-Majīd, al-Faʿʿālu li-mā yurīd, taʿlamu faraḥanā bi-mādhā wa-li-mādhā wa-ʿalā mādhā, wa-taʿlamu ḥuznanā ka-dhālik, wa-qad awjabta kawna mā aradtahu fīnā wa-minnā, wa-lā nasʾaluka dafʿa mā turīd, wa-lākin nasʾaluka t-taʾyīda bi-rūḥin min ʿindika fīmā turīd, kamā ayyadta anbiyāʾaka wa-rusulaka wa-khāṣṣata ṣ-ṣiddīqīna min khalqika, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

O Allāh, You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious Lord, the Doer of what He wills. You know our joy — in what, and for what, and over what; and You know our sorrow likewise. You have decreed that what You willed for us and from us shall be, and we do not ask You to avert what You will. Rather we ask You for support by a spirit from Your presence in what You will, as You supported Your prophets and Your messengers, and above all the truthful among Your creation. You have power over all things.

اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ، فَهَنِيئًا لِمَنْ عَرَفَكَ فَرَضِيَ بِقَضَائِكَ، وَالوَيْلُ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَعْرِفْكَ، بَلِ الوَيْلُ ثُمَّ الوَيْلُ لِمَنْ أَقَرَّ بِوَحْدَانِيَّتِكَ وَلَمْ يَرْضَ بِأَحْكَامِكَ

Allāhumma Fāṭira s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, ʿĀlima l-ghaybi wa-sh-shahādah, anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika, fa-hanīʾan li-man ʿarafaka fa-raḍiya bi-qaḍāʾika, wa-l-waylu li-man lam yaʿrifka, bali l-waylu thumma l-waylu li-man aqarra bi-waḥdāniyyatika wa-lam yarḍa bi-aḥkāmika.

O Allāh, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen: You judge between Your servants. How blessed is he who knows You and is content with Your decree; and woe to him who does not know You — indeed woe, and woe again, to him who acknowledges Your oneness yet is not content with Your rulings.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ القَوْمَ قَدْ حَكَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالذُّلِّ حَتَّىٰ عَزُّوا، وَحَكَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالفَقْدِ حَتَّىٰ وَجَدُوا، فَكُلُّ عِزٍّ يَمْنَعُ دُونَكَ فَنَسْأَلُكَ بَدَلَهُ ذُلًّا تَصْحَبُهُ لَطَائِفُ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَكُلُّ وَجْدٍ يَحْجُبُ عَنْكَ فَنَسْأَلُكَ عِوَضَهُ فَقْدًا تَصْحَبُهُ أَنْوَارُ مَحَبَّتِكَ، فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ ظَهَرَتِ السَّعَادَةُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَهُ، وَظَهَرَتِ الشَّقَاوَةُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ غَيْرُكَ مَلَكَهُ، فَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ مَوَاهِبِ السُّعَدَاءِ، وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْ مَوَارِدِ الأَشْقِيَاءِ

Allāhumma inna l-qawma qad ḥakamta ʿalayhim bi-dh-dhulli ḥattā ʿazzū, wa-ḥakamta ʿalayhim bi-l-faqdi ḥattā wajadū, fa-kullu ʿizzin yamnaʿu dūnaka fa-nasʾaluka badalahu dhullan taṣḥabuhu laṭāʾifu raḥmatika, wa-kullu wajdin yaḥjubu ʿanka fa-nasʾaluka ʿiwaḍahu faqdan taṣḥabuhu anwāru maḥabbatika, fa-innahu qad ẓaharati s-saʿādatu ʿalā man aḥbabtahu, wa-ẓaharati sh-shaqāwatu ʿalā man ghayruka malakahu, fa-hab lanā min mawāhibi s-suʿadāʾ, wa-ʿṣimnā min mawāridi l-ashqiyāʾ.

O Allāh, You decreed lowliness upon this people until they were exalted, and decreed loss upon them until they found. So every might that withholds short of You — we ask You for a lowliness in its place, attended by the subtleties of Your mercy; and every finding that veils from You — we ask You in exchange for it a loss attended by the lights of Your love. For felicity has appeared upon whomever You have loved, and wretchedness upon whomever another than You has possessed. So grant us of the gifts of the felicitous, and preserve us from the resorts of the wretched.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا قَدْ عَجِزْنَا عَنْ دَفْعِ الضُّرِّ عَنْ أَنْفُسِنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ نَعْلَمُ بِمَا نَعْلَمُ، فَكَيْفَ لَا نَعْجِزُ عَنْ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا نَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَا نَعْلَمُ وَقَدْ أَمَرْتَنَا وَنَهَيْتَنَا، وَالمَدْحَ وَالذَّمَّ أَلْزَمْتَنَا، فَأَخُو الصَّلَاحِ مَنْ أَصْلَحْتَهُ، وَأَخُو الفَسَادِ مَنْ أَضْلَلْتَهُ، وَالسَّعِيدُ حَقًّا مَنْ أَغْنَيْتَهُ عَنِ السُّؤَالِ مِنْكَ، وَالشَّقِيُّ حَقًّا مَنْ حَرَمْتَهُ مَعَ كَثْرَةِ السُّؤَالِ لَكَ، فَأَغْنِنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنْ سُؤَالِنَا مِنْكَ، وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَعَ كَثْرَةِ سُؤَالِنَا لَكَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Allāhumma innā qad ʿajaznā ʿan dafʿi ḍ-ḍurri ʿan anfusinā min ḥaythu naʿlamu bi-mā naʿlam, fa-kayfa lā naʿjizu ʿan dhālika min ḥaythu lā naʿlamu bi-mā lā naʿlam? Wa-qad amartanā wa-nahaytanā, wa-l-madḥa wa-dh-dhamma alzamtanā, fa-akhū ṣ-ṣalāḥi man aṣlaḥtahu, wa-akhū l-fasādi man aḍlaltahu, wa-s-saʿīdu ḥaqqan man aghnaytahu ʿani s-suʾāli minka, wa-sh-shaqiyyu ḥaqqan man ḥaramtahu maʿa kathrati s-suʾāli laka, fa-aghninā bi-faḍlika ʿan suʾālinā minka, wa-lā taḥrimnā min raḥmatika maʿa kathrati suʾālinā laka, wa-ghfir lanā, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

O Allāh, we are powerless to ward off harm from ourselves in what we know and by what we know — so how should we not be the more powerless in what we do not know and by what we do not know? You have commanded us and forbidden us, and bound us to praise and to blame. He is a man of righteousness whom You have set right, and a man of corruption whom You have led astray. Truly felicitous is he whom You have enriched beyond asking of You, and truly wretched is he whom You have deprived despite much asking of You. So enrich us by Your bounty beyond our asking of You, and do not deprive us of Your mercy despite our much asking of You. And forgive us: You have power over all things.

يَا شَدِيدَ البَطْشِ، يَا جَبَّارُ، يَا قَهَّارُ، يَا حَكِيمُ، نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقْتَ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ ظُلْمَةِ مَا أَبْدَعْتَ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ كَيْدِ النُّفُوسِ فِيمَا قَدَّرْتَ وَأَرَدْتَ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ الحُسَّادِ عَلَىٰ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ. وَنَسْأَلُكَ عِزَّ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ كَمَا سَأَلَكَهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ، عِزَّ الدُّنْيَا بِالإِيمَانِ وَالمَعْرِفَةِ، وَعِزَّ الآخِرَةِ بِاللِّقَاءِ وَالمُشَاهَدَةِ، إِنَّكَ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ

Yā Shadīda l-baṭsh, yā Jabbār, yā Qahhār, yā Ḥakīm, naʿūdhu bika min sharri mā khalaqta, wa-naʿūdhu bika min ẓulmati mā abdaʿta, wa-naʿūdhu bika min kaydi n-nufūsi fīmā qaddarta wa-aradta, wa-naʿūdhu bika min sharri l-ḥussādi ʿalā mā anʿamta. Wa-nasʾaluka ʿizza d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah kamā saʾalakahu Sayyidunā Muḥammadun ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam, ʿizza d-dunyā bi-l-īmāni wa-l-maʿrifah, wa-ʿizza l-ākhirati bi-l-liqāʾi wa-l-mushāhadah, innaka Samīʿun Qarībun Mujīb.

O You severe in seizing, O Compeller, O Overwhelming, O Wise: we take refuge in You from the evil of what You have created; and we take refuge in You from the darkness of what You have brought into being; and we take refuge in You from the guile of souls in what You have decreed and willed; and we take refuge in You from the evil of the envious over what You have bestowed. And we ask You for the might of this world and of the next, as our master Muḥammad — may Allāh bless him and grant him peace — asked it of You: the might of this world through faith and gnosis, and the might of the next through the meeting and the vision. You are Hearing, Near, Answering.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُقَدِّمُ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ كُلِّ نَفَسٍ وَلَحْظَةٍ وَطَرْفَةٍ يَطْرِفُ بِهَا أَهْلُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَأَهْلُ الأَرْضِ، وَكُلِّ شَيْءٍ هُوَ فِي عِلْمِكَ كَائِنٌ أَوْ قَدْ كَانَ، أُقَدِّمُ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ ذٰلِكَ كُلِّهِ: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٞ وَلَا نَوۡمٞۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ أَقْسَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ بِبَسْطِ يَدَيْكَ وَكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ وَنُورِ عَيْنَيْكَ وَكَمَالِ أَعْيُنِكَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَنَا خَيْرَ مَا نَفَذَتْ بِهِ مَشِيئَتُكَ، وَتَعَلَّقَتْ بِهِ قُدْرَتُكَ، وَأَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَاكْفِنَا شَرَّ مَا هُوَ ضِدٌّ لِذٰلِكَ، وَأَكْمِلْ لَنَا دِينَنَا، وَأَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ، وَهَبْ لَنَا حِكْمَةَ الحِكْمَةِ البَالِغَةِ مَعَ الحَيَاةِ الطَّيِّبَةِ وَالمَوْتَةِ الحَسَنَةِ، وَتَوَلَّ قَبْضَ أَرْوَاحِنَا بِيَدِكَ، وَحُلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ غَيْرِكَ فِي البَرْزَخِ وَمَا قَبْلَهُ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ بِنُورِ ذَاتِكَ وَعَظِيمِ قُدْرَتِكَ وَجَمِيلِ فَضْلِكَ، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin wa-laḥẓatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍ, wa-kulli shayʾin huwa fī ʿilmika kāʾinun aw qad kān, uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullih: ⟨ Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūm...Recite full Ayat al Kursi ⟩ . Aqsamtu ʿalayka bi-basṭi yadayka wa-karami wajhika wa-nūri ʿaynayka wa-kamāli aʿyunika an tuʿṭiyanā khayra mā nafadhat bihi mashīʾatuka, wa-taʿallaqat bihi qudratuka, wa-aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka, wa-kfinā sharra mā huwa ḍiddun li-dhālika, wa-akmil lanā dīnanā, wa-atmim ʿalaynā niʿmataka, wa-hab lanā ḥikmata l-ḥikmati l-bālighah maʿa l-ḥayāti ṭ-ṭayyibati wa-l-mawtati l-ḥasanah, wa-tawalla qabḍa arwāḥinā bi-yadika, wa-ḥul baynanā wa-bayna ghayrika fī l-barzakhi wa-mā qablahu wa-mā baʿdahu bi-nūri dhātika wa-ʿaẓīmi qudratika wa-jamīli faḍlika, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

O Allāh, I place before You — ahead of every breath and moment and glance with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth glance, and ahead of everything that in Your knowledge is or has been — I place before You, ahead of all of that: ⟨ the Throne Verse ⟩ . I adjure You by the outstretching of Your hands, the nobility of Your Face, the light of Your eyes and the perfection of Your regard, that You give us the best of what Your will has carried through, what Your power has attached to, and what Your knowledge has encompassed; and that You suffice us against the evil of whatever is contrary to that. Perfect for us our religion; complete Your favour upon us; and grant us the wisdom of consummate wisdom, together with a goodly life and a good death. Take our souls Yourself, into Your own hand; and come between us and all besides You in the barzakh, and before it and after it, by the light of Your Essence, the greatness of Your power and the beauty of Your bounty. You have power over all things.

يَا اللهُ يَا عَلِيُّ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا حَلِيمُ يَا حَكِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا قَرِيبُ يَا مُجِيبُ يَا وَدُودُ، حُلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالغَفْلَةِ وَالشَّهْوَةِ وَظُلْمِ العِبَادِ وَسُوءِ الخُلُقِ. وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا، وَاقْضِ عَنَّا تَبِعَاتِنَا، وَاكْشِفْ عَنَّا السُّوءَ، وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الغَمِّ، وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِنْهُ مَخْرَجًا، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Yā Allāh, yā ʿAlī, yā ʿAẓīm, yā Ḥalīm, yā Ḥakīm, yā Karīm, yā Samīʿ, yā Qarīb, yā Mujīb, yā Wadūd, ḥul baynanā wa-bayna fitnati d-dunyā wa-n-nisāʾi wa-l-ghaflati wa-sh-shahwati wa-ẓulmi l-ʿibādi wa-sūʾi l-khuluq. Wa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā, wa-qḍi ʿannā tabiʿātinā, wa-kshif ʿannā s-sūʾ, wa-najjinā mina l-ghamm, wa-jʿal lanā minhu makhrajan, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

O Allāh, O Most High, O Magnificent, O Forbearing, O Wise, O Generous, O Hearing, O Near, O Answering, O Loving: come between us and the trial of this world, and of women, and of heedlessness, and of appetite, and of wronging Your servants, and of bad character. Forgive us our sins; discharge for us our liabilities; lift from us evil; deliver us from grief and make for us a way out of it. You have power over all things.

يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ، يَا لَطِيفُ يَا رَزَّاقُ يَا قَوِيُّ يَا عَزِيزُ، لَكَ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، تَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَقْدِرُ، فَابْسُطْ لَنَا مِنَ الرِّزْقِ مَا تُوصِلُنَا بِهِ إِلَىٰ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَمِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا تَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ نَقِمَتِكَ، وَمِنْ حِلْمِكَ مَا يَسَعُنَا بِهِ عَفْوُكَ. وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالسَّعَادَةِ الَّتِي خَتَمْتَ بِهَا لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ خَيْرَ أَيَّامِنَا وَأَسْعَدَهَا يَوْمَ لِقَائِكَ، وَزَحْزِحْنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا عَنْ نَارِ الشَّهْوَةِ، وَأَدْخِلْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ فِي مَيَادِينِ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَاكْسُنَا مِنْ نُورِكَ جَلَابِيبَ العِصْمَةِ، وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا ظَهِيرًا مِنْ عُقُولِنَا، وَمُهَيْمِنًا مِنْ أَرْوَاحِنَا، وَمُسَخَّرًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِنَا، كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا، إِنَّكَ كُنْتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا

Yā Allāh, yā Allāh, yā Allāh, yā Allāh, yā Laṭīf, yā Razzāq, yā Qawī, yā ʿAzīz, laka maqālīdu s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, tabsuṭu r-rizqa li-man tashāʾu wa-taqdir, fa-bsuṭ lanā mina r-rizqi mā tūṣilunā bihi ilā raḥmatika, wa-min raḥmatika mā taḥūlu bihi baynanā wa-bayna naqimatika, wa-min ḥilmika mā yasaʿunā bihi ʿafwuka. Wa-khtim lanā bi-s-saʿādati llatī khatamta bihā li-awliyāʾika, wa-jʿal khayra ayyāminā wa-asʿadahā yawma liqāʾika, wa-zaḥziḥnā fī d-dunyā ʿan nāri sh-shahwah, wa-adkhilnā bi-faḍlika fī mayādīni r-raḥmah, wa-ksunā min nūrika jalābība l-ʿiṣmah, wa-jʿal lanā ẓahīran min ʿuqūlinā, wa-muhayminan min arwāḥinā, wa-musakhkharan min anfusinā, kay nusabbiḥaka kathīran wa-nadhkuraka kathīran, innaka kunta binā baṣīrā.

O Allāh, O Allāh, O Allāh, O Allāh; O Subtle, O Provider, O Strong, O Mighty: Yours are the keys of the heavens and the earth; You extend provision to whom You will, and measure it out. So extend to us of provision that by which You bring us to Your mercy; and of Your mercy that by which You come between us and Your retribution; and of Your forbearance that by which Your pardon may encompass us. Seal for us with the felicity with which You sealed for Your friends; make the best and most blessed of our days the day of meeting You; remove us in this world far from the fire of appetite; admit us by Your bounty into the fields of mercy; clothe us from Your light in the robes of protection; and appoint for us a support from our intellects, a guardian from our spirits and a subjected servant from our souls, that we may glorify You much and remember You much. You are ever Seeing of us.

وَهَبْ لَنَا مُشَاهَدَةً تَصْحَبُهَا مُكَالَمَةٌ، وَافْتَحْ أَسْمَاعَنَا وَأَبْصَارَنَا، وَاذْكُرْنَا إِذَا غَفَلْنَا عَنْكَ بِأَحْسَنَ مِمَّا تَذَكَّرْنَا بِهِ إِذَا ذَكَرْنَاكَ، وَارْحَمْنَا إِذَا عَصَيْنَاكَ بِأَتمّ مِمَّا تَرْحَمُنَا بِهِ إِذَا أَطَعْنَاكَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْهَا وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ، وَالْطُفْ بِنَا لُطْفًا يَحْجُبُنَا عَنْ غَيْرِكَ وَلَا يَحْجُبُنَا عَنْكَ، فَإِنَّكَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

Wa-hab lanā mushāhadatan taṣḥabuhā mukālamah, wa-ftaḥ asmāʿanā wa-abṣāranā, wa-dhkurnā idhā ghafalnā ʿanka bi-aḥsana mimmā tadhakkarnā bihi idhā dhakarnāka, wa-rḥamnā idhā ʿaṣaynāka bi-a’tamm mimmā tarḥamunā bihi idhā aṭaʿnāka, wa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā mā taqaddama minhā wa-mā taʾakhkhar, wa-lṭuf binā luṭfan yaḥjubunā ʿan ghayrika wa-lā yaḥjubunā ʿanka, fa-innaka bi-kulli shayʾin ʿalīm.

And grant us a witnessing attended by converse; and open our hearing and our sight; and remember us when we are heedless of You with better than the remembrance by which we were reminded when we remembered You; and have mercy on us when we disobey You more fully than the mercy You show us when we obey You; and forgive us our sins, those that went before and those that came after; and be gentle with us with a gentleness that veils us from all but You and does not veil us from You. You are Knower of all things.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ لِسَانًا رَطْبًا بِذِكْرِكَ، وَقَلْبًا مُنَعَّمًا بِشُكْرِكَ، وَبَدَنًا هَيِّنًا لَيِّنًا لِطَاعَتِكَ، وَأَعْطِنَا مَعَ ذٰلِكَ مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ، كَمَا أَخْبَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُكَ ﷺ، حَسْبَمَا عَلِمْتَهُ بِعِلْمِكَ. وَأَغْنِنَا بِلَا سَبَبٍ، وَاجْعَلْنَا سَبَبَ الغِنَىٰ لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَبَرْزَخًا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَعْدَائِكَ، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka lisānan raṭban bi-dhikrika, wa-qalban munaʿʿaman bi-shukrika, wa-badanan hayyinan layyinan li-ṭāʿatika, wa-aʿṭinā maʿa dhālika mā lā ʿaynun raʾat wa-lā udhunun samiʿat wa-lā khaṭara ʿalā qalbi basharin, kamā akhbara bihi rasūluka ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama, ḥasbamā ʿalimtahu bi-ʿilmika. Wa-aghninā bi-lā sabab, wa-jʿalnā sababa l-ghinā li-awliyāʾika, wa-barzakhan baynahum wa-bayna aʿdāʾika, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

O Allāh, we ask You for a tongue moist with Your remembrance, a heart made glad by thankfulness to You, and a body easy and pliant in Your obedience. And give us, along with that, what no eye has seen and no ear has heard and what has not occurred to the heart of any man — as Your Messenger, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace, told of it — according to what You know in Your knowledge. Enrich us without means; and make us a means of enrichment for Your friends, and a barrier between them and Your enemies. You have power over all things.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا دَائِمًا، وَنَسْأَلُكَ قَلْبًا خَاشِعًا، وَنَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَنَسْأَلُكَ يَقِينًا صَادِقًا، وَنَسْأَلُكَ دِينًا قَيِّمًا، وَنَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ، وَنَسْأَلُكَ تَمَامَ العَافِيَةِ، وَنَسْأَلُكَ دَوَامَ العَافِيَةِ، وَنَسْأَلُكَ الشُّكْرَ عَلَى العَافِيَةِ، وَنَسْأَلُكَ الغِنَىٰ عَنِ النَّاسِ

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka īmānan dāʾiman, wa-nasʾaluka qalban khāshiʿan, wa-nasʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa-nasʾaluka yaqīnan ṣādiqan, wa-nasʾaluka dīnan qayyiman, wa-nasʾaluka l-ʿāfiyata min kulli baliyyah, wa-nasʾaluka tamāma l-ʿāfiyah, wa-nasʾaluka dawāma l-ʿāfiyah, wa-nasʾaluka sh-shukra ʿalā l-ʿāfiyah, wa-nasʾaluka l-ghinā ʿani n-nās.

O Allāh, we ask You for enduring faith; and we ask You for a humble heart; and we ask You for beneficial knowledge; and we ask You for true certainty; and we ask You for an upright religion; and we ask You for well-being from every affliction; and we ask You for the fullness of well-being; and we ask You for the continuance of well-being; and we ask You for thankfulness for well-being; and we ask You for independence from people.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ التَّوْبَةَ الكَامِلَةَ، وَالمَغْفِرَةَ الشَّامِلَةَ، وَالمَحَبَّةَ الجَامِعَةَ، وَالخُلَّةَ الصَّافِيَةَ، وَالمَعْرِفَةَ الوَاسِعَةَ، وَالأَنْوَارَ السَّاطِعَةَ، وَالشَّفَاعَةَ القَائِمَةَ، وَالحُجَّةَ البَالِغَةَ، وَالدَّرَجَةَ العَالِيَةَ، وَفَكَّ وَثَاقِنَا مِنَ المَعْصِيَةِ، وَرِهَانَنَا مِنَ النَّقْمَةِ بِمَوَاهِبِ المِنَّةِ

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka t-tawbata l-kāmilah, wa-l-maghfirata sh-shāmilah, wa-l-maḥabbata l-jāmiʿah, wa-l-khullata ṣ-ṣāfiyah, wa-l-maʿrifata l-wāsiʿah, wa-l-anwāra s-sāṭiʿah, wa-sh-shafāʿata l-qāʾimah, wa-l-ḥujjata l-bālighah, wa-d-darajata l-ʿāliyah, wa-fakka wathāqinā mina l-maʿṣiyah, wa-rihānanā mina n-naqmati bi-mawāhibi l-minnah.

O Allāh, we ask You for complete repentance, all-embracing forgiveness, gathering love, pure friendship, wide gnosis, radiant lights, standing intercession, the conclusive proof and the lofty degree. And loose our bond from disobedience, and our pledge from retribution, by the gifts of Your favour.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ التَّوْبَةَ وَدَوَامَهَا، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ المَعْصِيَةِ وَأَسْبَابِهَا، فَذَكِّرْنَا بِالخَوْفِ مِنْكَ قَبْلَ هُجُومِ خَطَرَاتِهَا، وَاحْمِلْنَا عَلَى النَّجَاةِ مِنْهَا وَمِنَ التَّفَكُّرِ فِي طَرَائِقِهَا، وَامْحُ مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا حَلَاوَةَ مَا اجْتَنَيْنَاهُ مِنْهَا، وَاسْتَبْدِلْهَا بِالكَرَاهَةِ لَهَا وَالطُّعْمِ لِمَا هُوَ بِضِدِّهَا. وَأَفِضْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ بَحْرِ كَرَمِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَعَفْوِكَ حَتَّىٰ نَخْرُجَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى السَّلَامَةِ مِنْ وَبَالِهَا، وَاجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَ المَوْتِ نَاطِقِينَ بِالشَّهَادَةِ، عَالِمِينَ بِهَا

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka t-tawbata wa-dawāmahā, wa-naʿūdhu bika mina l-maʿṣiyati wa-asbābihā, fa-dhakkirnā bi-l-khawfi minka qabla hujūmi khaṭarātihā, wa-ḥmilnā ʿalā n-najāti minhā wa-mina t-tafakkuri fī ṭarāʾiqihā, wa-mḥu min qulūbinā ḥalāwata mā ijtanaynāhu minhā, wa-stabdilhā bi-l-karāhati lahā wa-ṭ-ṭuʿmi li-mā huwa bi-ḍiddihā. Wa-afiḍ ʿalaynā min baḥri karamika wa-faḍlika wa-jūdika wa-ʿafwika ḥattā nakhruja mina d-dunyā ʿalā s-salāmati min wabālihā, wa-jʿalnā ʿinda l-mawti nāṭiqīna bi-sh-shahādah, ʿālimīna bihā.

O Allāh, we ask You for repentance and for its continuance, and we take refuge in You from disobedience and its causes. So remind us with fear of You before the onslaught of its promptings; and carry us to deliverance from it and from dwelling upon its paths; and erase from our hearts the sweetness of what we have gathered from it, and put in its place a loathing for it and a taste for what is its opposite. And pour upon us from the sea of Your generosity and bounty and munificence and pardon, until we leave this world safe from its ruinous consequence; and make us, at death, utter the testimony, knowing it.
وَارْأَفْ بِنَا رَأْفَةَ الحَبِيبِ بِحَبِيبِهِ عِنْدَ الشَّدَائِدِ وَنُزُولِهَا، وَأَرِحْنَا مِنْ هُمُومِ الدُّنْيَا وَغُمُومِهَا بِالرَّوْحِ وَالرَّيْحَانِ إِلَى الجَنَّةِ وَنَعِيمِهَا
Wa-rʾaf binā raʾfata l-ḥabībi bi-ḥabībihi ʿinda sh-shadāʾidi wa-nuzūlihā, wa-ariḥnā min humūmi d-dunyā wa-ghumūmihā bi-r-rawḥi wa-r-rayḥāni ilā l-jannati wa-naʿīmihā.

And be tender with us with the tenderness of a lover to his beloved at the coming of hardships; and give us rest from the cares and sorrows of this world by repose and sweet fragrance, unto the Garden and its bliss.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ تَوْبَةً سَابِقَةً مِنْكَ إِلَيْنَا لِتَكُونَ تَوْبَتُنَا تَابِعَةً إِلَيْكَ مِنَّا، وَهَبْ لَنَا التَّلَقِّيَ مِنْكَ كَتَلَقِّي آدَمَ مِنْكَ الكَلِمَاتِ، لِيَكُونَ قُدْوَةً لِوَلَدِهِ فِي التَّوْبَةِ وَالأَعْمَالِ الصَّالِحَاتِ. وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ العِنَادِ وَالإِصْرَارِ وَالشَّبَهِ بِإِبْلِيسَ رَأْسِ الغُوَاةِ. وَاجْعَلْ سَيِّئَاتِنَا سَيِّئَاتِ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ حَسَنَاتِنَا حَسَنَاتِ مَنْ أَبْغَضْتَ، فَالإِحْسَانُ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَعَ البُغْضِ مِنْكَ، وَالإِسَاءَةُ لَا تَضُرُّ مَعَ الحُبِّ مِنْكَ

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka tawbatan sābiqatan minka ilaynā li-takūna tawbatunā tābiʿatan ilayka minnā, wa-hab lanā t-talaqqī minka ka-talaqqī Ādama minka l-kalimāt, li-yakūna qudwatan li-waladihi fī t-tawbati wa-l-aʿmāli ṣ-ṣāliḥāt. Wa-bāʿid baynanā wa-bayna l-ʿinādi wa-l-iṣrāri wa-sh-shabahi bi-Iblīsa raʾsi l-ghuwāh. Wa-jʿal sayyiʾātinā sayyiʾāti man aḥbabta, wa-lā tajʿal ḥasanātinā ḥasanāti man abghaḍta, fa-l-iḥsānu lā yanfaʿu maʿa l-bughḍi minka, wa-l-isāʾatu lā taḍurru maʿa l-ḥubbi minka.

O Allāh, we ask You for a repentance preceding from You to us, that our repentance may follow to You from us. And grant us the receiving from You as Ādam received the words from You, that he might be a model for his children in repentance and in righteous deeds. And set far between us and obstinacy and persistence and any likeness to Iblīs, the chief of the misguided. And make our evil deeds the evil deeds of one You love, and do not make our good deeds the good deeds of one You detest — for doing well profits nothing where there is detestation from You, and doing ill does no harm where there is love from You.

وَقَدْ أَبْهَمْتَ الأَمْرَ عَلَيْنَا لِنَرْجُوَ وَنَخَافَ، فَآمِنْ خَوْفَنَا وَلَا تُخَيِّبْ رَجَاءَنَا، وَأَعْطِنَا سُؤْلَنَا، فَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتَنَا الإِيمَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ نَسْأَلَكَ، وَكَتَبْتَ وَحَبَّبْتَ وَزَيَّنْتَ وَكَرَّهْتَ، وَأَطْلَقْتَ الأَلْسُنَ بِمَا بِهِ تَرْجَمَتْ، فَنِعْمَ الرَّبُّ أَنْتَ، فَلَكَ الحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا، وَلَا تُعَاقِبْنَا بِالسَّلْبِ بَعْدَ العَطَاءِ، وَلَا بِكُفْرَانِ النِّعَمِ وَحِرْمَانِ الرِّضَا

Wa-qad abhamta l-amra ʿalaynā li-narjuwa wa-nakhāf, fa-āmin khawfanā wa-lā tukhayyib rajāʾanā, wa-aʿṭinā suʾlanā, fa-qad aʿṭaytanā l-īmāna min qabli an nasʾalaka, wa-katabta wa-ḥabbabta wa-zayyanta wa-karrahta, wa-aṭlaqta l-alsuna bi-mā bihi tarjamat, fa-niʿma r-Rabbu anta, fa-laka l-ḥamdu ʿalā mā anʿamta, fa-ghfir lanā, wa-lā tuʿāqibnā bi-s-salbi baʿda l-ʿaṭāʾ, wa-lā bi-kufrāni n-niʿami wa-ḥirmāni r-riḍā.

You have left the matter obscure to us, that we may hope and fear. So make our fear secure, and do not disappoint our hope, and give us our request. You gave us faith before we asked You; and You wrote, and endeared, and adorned, and made hateful; and You loosed the tongues with what they voiced of it. What an excellent Lord You are! To You be praise for what You have bestowed. So forgive us, and do not punish us by taking away after giving, nor by ingratitude for blessings and deprivation of contentment.

اللَّهُمَّ رَضِّنَا بِقَضَائِكَ، وَصَبِّرْنَا عَلَىٰ طَاعَتِكَ وَعَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَعَنِ الشَّهَوَاتِ المُوجِبَاتِ لِلنَّقْصِ أَوِ البُعْدِ عَنْكَ، وَهَبْ لَنَا حَقِيقَةَ الإِيمَانِ بِكَ حَتَّىٰ لَا نَخَافَ غَيْرَكَ، وَلَا نَرْجُوَ غَيْرَكَ، وَلَا نُحِبَّ غَيْرَكَ، وَلَا نَعْبُدَ شَيْئًا سِوَاكَ، وَأَوْزِعْنَا شُكْرَ نَعْمَائِكَ، وَغَطِّنَا بِرِدَاءِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَانْصُرْنَا بِاليَقِينِ وَالتَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ، وَأَسْفِرْ وُجُوهَنَا بِنُورِ صَفَائِكَ، وَأَضْحِكْنَا وَبَشِّرْنَا يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ بَيْنَ أَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَبْسُوطَةً عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَىٰ أَهْلِينَا وَأَوْلَادِنَا وَمَنْ مَعَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَلَا تَكِلْنَا إِلَىٰ أَنْفُسِنَا طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَلَا أَقَلَّ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ، يَا نِعْمَ المُجِيبُ

Allāhumma raḍḍinā bi-qaḍāʾika, wa-ṣabbirnā ʿalā ṭāʿatika wa-ʿan maʿṣiyatika wa-ʿani sh-shahawāti l-mūjibāti li-n-naqṣi awi l-buʿdi ʿanka, wa-hab lanā ḥaqīqata l-īmāni bika ḥattā lā nakhāfa ghayraka, wa-lā narjuwa ghayraka, wa-lā nuḥibba ghayraka, wa-lā naʿbuda shayʾan siwāka, wa-awziʿnā shukra naʿmāʾika, wa-ghaṭṭinā bi-ridāʾi ʿāfiyatika, wa-nṣurnā bi-l-yaqīni wa-t-tawakkuli ʿalayka, wa-asfir wujūhanā bi-nūri ṣafāʾika, wa-aḍḥiknā wa-bashshirnā yawma l-qiyāmati bayna awliyāʾika, wa-jʿal yadaka mabsūṭatan ʿalaynā wa-ʿalā ahlīnā wa-awlādinā wa-man maʿanā bi-raḥmatika, wa-lā takilnā ilā anfusinā ṭarfata ʿaynin wa-lā aqalla min dhālika, yā Niʿma l-Mujīb.

O Allāh, make us content with Your decree; and make us patient in obeying You, and in refraining from disobeying You, and from the appetites that entail deficiency or distance from You. And grant us the reality of faith in You, so that we fear none but You, and hope in none but You, and love none but You, and worship nothing besides You. And inspire us with thankfulness for Your favours; and cover us with the mantle of Your well-being; and aid us with certainty and with reliance upon You; and brighten our faces with the light of Your purity; and make us laugh and give us good tidings on the Day of Rising among Your friends; and keep Your hand outstretched over us and over our families and our children.

يَا مَنْ هُوَ، وَهُوَ فِي عُلُوِّهِ قَرِيبٌ، يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ، يَا مُحِيطًا بِاللَّيَالِي وَالأَيَّامِ، أَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ مِنْ غَمِّ الحِجَابِ وَسُوءِ الحِسَابِ وَشِدَّةِ العَذَابِ، وَإِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَوَاقِعٌ مَا لَهُ مِنْ دَافِعٍ، إِنْ لَمْ تَرْحَمْنِي: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

Yā Man huwa, wa-huwa fī ʿuluwwihi qarīb, yā Dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ikrām, yā Muḥīṭan bi-l-layālī wa-l-ayyām, ashkū ilayka min ghammi l-ḥijābi wa-sūʾi l-ḥisābi wa-shiddati l-ʿadhāb, wa-inna dhālika la-wāqiʿun mā lahu min dāfiʿ, in lam tarḥamnī: ⟨ Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn ⟩ .

O He who is — and who, in His exaltedness, is near — O Possessor of majesty and honour, O You who encompass the nights and the days: I complain to You of the grief of the veil, and the evil of the reckoning, and the severity of the punishment; and that is surely to come, and none can avert it. If You do not have mercy upon me: there is no god but You; glory be to You, I was among the wrongdoers.

وَلَقَدْ شَكَا إِلَيْكَ يَعْقُوبُ فَخَلَّصْتَهُ مِنْ حُزْنِهِ، وَرَدَدْتَ عَلَيْهِ مَا ذَهَبَ مِنْ بَصَرِهِ، وَجَمَعْتَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ وَلَدِهِ. وَلَقَدْ نَادَاكَ نُوحٌ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَنَجَّيْتَهُ مِنْ كَرْبِهِ. وَلَقَدْ نَادَاكَ أَيُّوبُ مِنْ بَعْدُ فَكَشَفْتَ مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرِّهِ. وَلَقَدْ نَادَاكَ يُونُسُ فَنَجَّيْتَهُ مِنْ غَمِّهِ. وَلَقَدْ نَادَاكَ زَكَرِيَّا فَوَهَبْتَ لَهُ وَلَدًا مِنْ صُلْبِهِ بَعْدَ يَأْسِ أَهْلِهِ وَكِبَرِ سِنِّهِ. وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا نَزَلَ بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَأَنْقَذْتَهُ مِنْ نَارِ عَدُوِّهِ، وَأَنْجَيْتَ لُوطًا وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ العَذَابِ النَّازِلِ بِقَوْمِهِ

Wa-laqad shakā ilayka Yaʿqūbu fa-khallaṣtahu min ḥuznihi, wa-radadta ʿalayhi mā dhahaba min baṣarihi, wa-jamaʿta baynahu wa-bayna waladih. Wa-laqad nādāka Nūḥun min qablu fa-najjaytahu min karbih. Wa-laqad nādāka Ayyūbu min baʿdu fa-kashafta mā bihi min ḍurrih. Wa-laqad nādāka Yūnusu fa-najjaytahu min ghammih. Wa-laqad nādāka Zakariyyā fa-wahabta lahu waladan min ṣulbihi baʿda yaʾsi ahlihi wa-kibari sinnih. Wa-laqad ʿalimta mā nazala bi-Ibrāhīma fa-anqadhtahu min nāri ʿaduwwih, wa-anjayta Lūṭan wa-ahlahu mina l-ʿadhābi n-nāzili bi-qawmih.

Yaʿqūb complained to You, and You freed him from his sorrow, and restored to him the sight that had gone, and joined him with his son. And Nūḥ called upon You before that, and You delivered him from his distress. And Ayyūb called upon You afterward, and You lifted the harm that was upon him. And Yūnus called upon You, and You delivered him from his grief. And Zakariyyā called upon You, and You granted him a son from his own loins after his family had despaired and he was advanced in years. And You knew what befell Ibrāhīm, and You rescued him from the fire of his enemy; and You delivered Lūṭ and his family from the punishment that came down upon his people.

فَهَا أَنَا ذَا عَبْدُكَ، إِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي بِجَمِيعِ مَا عَلِمْتَ مِنْ عَذَابِكَ فَأَنَا حَقِيقٌ بِهِ، وَإِنْ تَرْحَمْنِي كَمَا رَحِمْتَهُمْ مَعَ عَظِيمِ إِجْرَامِي فَأَنْتَ أَوْلَىٰ بِذٰلِكَ وَأَحَقُّ مَنْ أَكْرَمَ بِهِ، فَلَيْسَ كَرَمُكَ مَخْصُوصًا بِمَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْكَ، بَلْ هُوَ مَبْذُولٌ بِالسَّبْقِ لِمَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَإِنْ عَصَاكَ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنْكَ. وَلَيْسَ مِنَ الكَرَمِ أَنْ لَا تُحْسِنَ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنْتَ المُفْضَالُ الغَنِيُّ، بَلْ مِنَ الكَرَمِ أَنْ تُحْسِنَ إِلَىٰ مَنْ أَسَاءَ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنْتَ الرَّحِيمُ العَلِيُّ. كَيْفَ، وَقَدْ أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُحْسِنَ إِلَىٰ مَنْ أَسَاءَ إِلَيْنَا، فَأَنْتَ أَوْلَىٰ بِذٰلِكَ مِنَّا

Fa-hā anā dhā ʿabduka, in tuʿadhdhibnī bi-jamīʿi mā ʿalimta min ʿadhābika fa-anā ḥaqīqun bih, wa-in tarḥamnī kamā raḥimtahum maʿa ʿaẓīmi ijrāmī fa-anta awlā bi-dhālika wa-aḥaqqu man akrama bih, fa-laysa karamuka makhṣūṣan bi-man aṭāʿaka wa-aqbala ʿalayka, bal huwa mabdhūlun bi-s-sabqi li-man shiʾta min khalqika, wa-in ʿaṣāka wa-aʿraḍa ʿanka. Wa-laysa mina l-karami an lā tuḥsina illā li-man aḥsana ilayka wa-anta l-Mufḍālu l-Ghanī, bal mina l-karami an tuḥsina ilā man asāʾa ilayka wa-anta r-Raḥīmu l-ʿAlī. Kayfa, wa-qad amartanā an nuḥsina ilā man asāʾa ilaynā, fa-anta awlā bi-dhālika minnā.

So here I am, Your slave. If You punish me with all the punishment You know of, I am deserving of it; and if You have mercy upon me as You had mercy upon them, despite the enormity of my offence, You are the more worthy of that and the most deserving to be generous with it. For Your generosity is not confined to those who obey You and turn toward You; rather it is bestowed in precedence upon whom You will of Your creation, even if he disobeys You and turns away from You. It is not of generosity that You should do good only to one who has done good to You, when You are the Bountiful, the Self-Sufficient; rather it is of generosity that You do good to one who has done ill to You, when You are the Merciful, the Most High. How should it be otherwise — when You have commanded us to do good to whoever does ill to us? So You are more worthy of that than we.
رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الخَاسِرِينَ
⟨ Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa-in lam taghfir lanā wa-tarḥamnā la-nakūnanna mina l-khāsirīn ⟩
Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves; and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we shall surely be among the losers.

يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ، يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيمُ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، يَا مَنْ هُوَ وَهُوَ، يَا هُوَ. إِنْ لَمْ نَكُنْ لِرَحْمَتِكَ أَهْلًا أَنْ نَنَالَهَا، فَرَحْمَتُكَ أَهْلٌ أَنْ تَنَالَنَا، يَا رَبَّاهُ يَا مَوْلَاهُ، يَا مُغِيثَ مَنْ عَصَاهُ، أَغِثْنَا أَغِثْنَا أَغِثْنَا يَا رَبُّ يَا كَرِيمُ، وَارْحَمْنَا يَا بَرُّ يَا رَحِيمُ، يَا مَنْ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلَا يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ العَلِيُّ العَظِيمُ

Yā Allāh, yā Allāh, yā Allāh, yā Allāh, yā Raḥmān, yā Raḥīm, yā Ḥayy, yā Qayyūm, yā Man huwa wa-huwa, yā Huwa. In lam nakun li-raḥmatika ahlan an nanālahā, fa-raḥmatuka ahlun an tanālanā, yā Rabbāh, yā Mawlāh, yā Mughītha man ʿaṣāh, aghithnā aghithnā aghithnā yā Rabb, yā Karīm, wa-rḥamnā yā Barr, yā Raḥīm, yā Man wasiʿa kursiyyuhu s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, wa-lā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wa-huwa l-ʿAliyyu l-ʿAẓīm.

O Allāh, O Allāh, O Allāh, O Allāh; O All-Merciful, O Ever-Merciful; O Living, O Self-Subsisting; O He who is, and who is; O He. If we are not worthy of Your mercy that we should attain it, Your mercy is worthy that it should attain us. O my Lord, O my Master, O Succourer of him who has disobeyed Him: succour us, succour us, succour us, O Lord, O Generous; and have mercy upon us, O Benign, O Merciful — O You whose Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not weary Him, and He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

أَسْأَلُكَ الإِيمَانَ بِحِفْظِكَ إِيمَانًا يَسْكُنُ بِهِ قَلْبِي مِنْ هَمِّ الرِّزْقِ وَخَوْفِ الخَلْقِ، وَأَقْرِبْ مِنِّي بِقُدْرَتِكَ قُرْبًا تَمْحُو بِهِ عَنِّي كُلَّ حِجَابٍ مَحَقْتَهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ، فَلَمْ يَحْتَجْ لِجِبْرِيلَ رَسُولِكَ وَلَا لِسُؤَالِه مِنْكَ، وَحَجَبْتَهُ بِذٰلِكَ عَنْ نَارِ عَدُوِّهِ. وَكَيْفَ لَا يُحْجَبُ عَنْ مَضَرَّةِ الأَعْدَاءِ مَنْ غَيَّبْتَهُ عَنْ مَنْفَعَةِ الأَحِبَّاءِ كَلَّا، إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُغَيِّبَنِي بِقُرْبِكَ مِنِّي حَتَّىٰ لَا أَرَىٰ وَلَا أَسْمَعَ وَلَا أَجِدَ وَلَا أُحِسَّ بِقُرْبِ شَيْءٍ وَلَا ببُعْدِهِ عَنِّي، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

Asʾaluka l-īmāna bi-ḥifẓika īmānan yaskunu bihi qalbī min hammi r-rizqi wa-khawfi l-khalq, wa-aqrib minnī bi-qudratika qurban tamḥū bihi ʿannī kulla ḥijābin maḥaqtahu ʿan Ibrāhīma khalīlika, fa-lam yaḥtaj li-Jibrīla rasūlika wa-lā li-suʾālihi minka, wa-ḥajabtahu bi-dhālika ʿan nāri ʿaduwwih. Wa-kayfa lā yuḥjabu ʿan maḍarrati l-aʿdāʾi man ghayyabtahu ʿan manfaʿati l-aḥibbāʾ? Kallā, innī asʾaluka an tughayyibanī bi-qurbika minnī ḥattā lā arā wa-lā asmaʿa wa-lā ajida wa-lā uḥissa bi-qurbi shayʾin wa-lā bi-buʿdihi ʿannī, innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

I ask You for faith in Your safekeeping — a faith by which my heart is stilled from anxiety over provision and from fear of created things. And draw near to me by Your power with a nearness by which You erase from me every veil that You effaced from Ibrāhīm Your intimate friend, so that he needed neither Jibrīl Your messenger nor to ask anything of You — and by that You veiled him from the fire of his enemy. And how should he not be veiled from the harm of enemies whom You have made absent from the benefit of loved ones? No indeed: I ask You to make me absent through Your nearness to me, until I neither see nor hear nor find nor sense the nearness of anything, nor its distance from me. You have power over all things.

أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ المَلِكُ الحَقُّ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَرِيمِ وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الكَافِرُونَ وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

⟨ Afa-ḥasibtum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ilaynā lā turjaʿūn. Fa-taʿālā llāhu l-Maliku l-Ḥaqq, lā ilāha illā huwa Rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm. Wa-man yadʿu maʿa llāhi ilāhan ākhara lā burhāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi, innahu lā yufliḥu l-kāfirūn. Wa-qul Rabbi-ghfir wa-rḥam wa-anta khayru r-rāḥimīn ⟩ .

Did you think that We created you in vain, and that you would not be returned to Us? Exalted be Allāh, the True King; there is no god but He, Lord of the Noble Throne. And whoever calls upon another god alongside Allāh, for which he has no proof — his reckoning is only with his Lord. Truly the disbelievers will not prosper. And say: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
هُوَ الحَيُّ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ ۗ الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ
⟨ Huwa l-Ḥayyu lā ilāha illā huwa fa-dʿūhu mukhliṣīna lahu d-dīn, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn ⟩ .
He is the Living; there is no god but He. So call upon Him, making religion sincerely His. Praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
⟨ Inna llāha wa-malāʾikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā n-Nabī, yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wa-sallimū taslīmā ⟩ .
Truly Allāh and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, invoke blessings upon him and greet him with peace.

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli Sayyidinā Muḥammadin, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli Sayyidinā Ibrāhīma, wa-bārik ʿalā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā āli Sayyidinā Muḥammadin, kamā bārakta ʿalā Sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa-ʿalā āli Sayyidinā Ibrāhīma fī l-ʿālamīna, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.

O Allāh, bless our master Muḥammad and the family of our master Muḥammad, as You blessed our master Ibrāhīm and the family of our master Ibrāhīm; and send grace upon our master Muḥammad and the family of our master Muḥammad, as You sent grace upon our master Ibrāhīm and the family of our master Ibrāhīm among the worlds. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

اللَّهُمَّ وَارْضَ عَنْ سَادَاتِنَا الخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ: أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيٍّ، وَعَنِ الحَسَنِ وَعَنِ الحُسَيْنِ وَعَنْ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ، وَعَنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الطَّاهِرَاتِ أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ، وَعَنِ الصَّحَابَةِ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَالتَّابِعِينَ وَتَابِعِيهِمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ. وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ

Allāhumma wa-rḍa ʿan sādātinā l-khulafāʾi r-rāshidīn: Abī Bakrin wa-ʿUmara wa-ʿUthmāna wa-ʿAliyyin, wa-ʿani l-Ḥasani wa-ʿani l-Ḥusayni wa-ʿan Fāṭimata z-Zahrāʾ, wa-ʿan azwāji n-Nabiyyi ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama ṭ-ṭāhirāti ummahāti l-muʾminīn, wa-ʿani ṣ-ṣaḥābati ajmaʿīn, wa-t-tābiʿīna wa-tābiʿīhim bi-iḥsānin ilā yawmi d-dīn. Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm.

O Allāh, and be pleased with our masters the Rightly-Guided Caliphs: Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthmān and ʿAlī; and with al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn, and with Fāṭima al-Zahrāʾ; and with the pure wives of the Prophet, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace, the Mothers of the Believers; and with all the Companions, and the Followers, and those who follow them in excellence until the Day of Judgement. And there is no power and no strength save by Allāh, the Most High, the Magnificent.
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ العِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى المُرْسَلِينَ وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ
⟨ Subḥāna Rabbika Rabbi l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūn. Wa-salāmun ʿalā l-mursalīn. Wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn ⟩ .
Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
Ḥizb al-Barr — 36 bands. Imām Abū al-Ḥasan al-Shādhilī, d. 656 AH / 1258 CE.
